sources.title: CDC CTTL: Riot Control Agents
sources.interpretation: Chemical irritants can cause severe injury, particularly with substantial or prolonged exposure in enclosed settings. Hazard context only; no validation of automatic teargas or school deployment.

sources.title: OSHA eTool: Design and construction requirements for exit routes
sources.interpretation: General employee-egress guidance addresses inside opening and emergency usability. School-specific applicability, exceptions and designs require qualified review; no authority for automatic confinement is established.
